item.text: I’m narrowing this to the pieces that actually move a 3B judgment: inherited Duterte-era abuse, Marcos’s own rhetoric and appointments, protest handling, and whether there was any meaningful accountability or remedy in 2022. I’m aiming for a compact set of primary/independent sources, not a broad catalog of general rights reporting.
